summary: Six churches in three clustered parishes. The bulletins have no schedule box: weekly Masses come from the Mass intentions and Confessions from the confession lines on pages 3 to 5 (matching in all five bulletins, with the websites agreeing), and Adoration from sidebar notices (Monday at St. Mary Magdalene, first Friday at Lyons, last Thursday at Clyde, Wednesday evening at Newark), all timed after the Mass by POLICY. St. Jude is summer only, and the Newark Monday Mass at a senior living center is left out. Nothing open; Clyde Sunday Confession appears only in the last two issues (R35).
